selected_evidence.requirement: node1 has a fixed address of its own on the shared network
selected_evidence.summary: network.lan.proto set to static with ipaddr 10.100.169.10; confirmed via ubus interface status and ip addr both before and after node1's restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 runs a DHCP service for node2 and node3
selected_evidence.summary: dnsmasq DHCP server enabled (forced past platform-DHCP self-protection), listening on udp/67, and shown in dnsmasq-dhcp logs actively processing DHCPDISCOVER/DHCPREQUEST from node2 and node3 MAC addresses both before and after node1's restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: rule refusing TCP port 23 from that network
selected_evidence.summary: Firewall rule 'Refuse-Telnet-LAN' committed and confirmed present in nft ruleset; live nc tests from node2 and node3 show tcp/23 refused (exit 1) while tcp/80 remains open (exit 0), both before and after all node restarts.

selected_evidence.requirement: settings still in place and serving traffic after node1 restart
selected_evidence.summary: After node1's reboot: uci changes empty (fully committed), static IP/DHCP-server config/firewall rule all intact, dnsmasq and network services running, live DHCP protocol exchanges and telnet-block/http-open tests from node2/node3 all pass.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart with changed boot identity and recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id 2dbf0f75... and health; issued backgrounded reboot (ack returned, then connection timed out confirming disconnect); polled until exec returned with new boot_id 9d3fa534... and uptime reset to ~24s; verified recovered config/services.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart with changed boot identity and recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id f3c5ecf3...; issued reboot (connection reset confirming disconnect); polled until exec returned with new boot_id 2590b37b... and uptime reset to ~14s; verified network connectivity and node1 firewall/DHCP interaction restored.

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart with changed boot identity and recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id 095137f5...; issued reboot (connection reset confirming disconnect); polled until exec returned with new boot_id 352dcc0c... and uptime reset to ~18s; verified network connectivity and node1 firewall/DHCP interaction restored.

	prefix_or_netmask="${subnet##*/}"

	config_get netmask "$cfg" netmask

	config_get_bool dynamicdhcpv6 "$cfg" dynamicdhcpv6 $dynamicdhcp

	start="$( dhcp_calc "$start" )"

	add_tag() {

	}

	nettag="${networkid:+set:${networkid},}"

	# make sure the DHCP range is not empty
